points.problem: perf:budget falsely passed with 0 JS chunks when build was absent and could count stale hashed files.
points.implementation: Gate fails closed without real build/manifest and accounts only current manifest assets.
points.evidence: VPS current artifact: 130 active JS chunks, 1.13 MiB gzip under unchanged 1.25 MiB threshold.

points.problem: Initial-JS gate passed without exposing headroom, CSS footprint or largest JS chunk, making regressions harder to trend.
points.implementation: Performance output now reports initial JS gzip versus 250 KiB budget and percentage, active CSS gzip, and largest JS chunk without relaxing thresholds.
points.evidence: VPS artifact PASS: initial JS 121 KiB / 250 KiB (48.5%); active CSS 69 chunks / 315 KiB gzip; largest JS chunk 294 KiB; total JS 1.13 MiB.

points.problem: Global reduced-motion support existed but had no automated regression guard.
Production smoke could silently pass after loss of baseline browser security headers.
Initial-load JS regressions could hide inside total budget.
Global keyboard focus treatment had no automated regression contract.
New JSX images could be introduced without alt semantics.

Static PWA smoke did not prove start_url remained inside scope and accepted install-app integration based on loose string presence rather than a coherent HTTPS script tag targeting Cutinapp manifest/service worker.
points.implementation: PWA guard now resolves start_url/scope on the production origin, fails if start_url escapes scope, requires explicit HTTPS install-app.js integration, and verifies data-manifest=/manifest.json, root data-sw=/sw.js and data-app-slug=cutinapp on that same script tag.
points.evidence: Git fallback commit bf73c240d78ea33d8a864a1aceb67a8089ff4178 on main. Current index integration matches the strengthened contract. VPS offline, so Chrome Android beforeinstallprompt/install/runtime validation remains pending.
points.next: When VPS returns, sync main, run npm run smoke:pwa, then validate HTTPS, SW control, 192/512/maskable intrinsic icon dimensions and real Chrome Android beforeinstallprompt/install flow.
